item.title: A New Chapter
item.description:
Hi everyone,

This December, THE FINALS turns three. That's three years of cashouts, best-in-class destruction and unscripted moments that no one saw coming. The game has changed a lot in that time, and plenty of what's in it today started as feedback you provided, or something we noticed from watching how you actually play.

-Players are able to clip through the ground of some structures on Broken Moon

-Game settings reset on startup for some players

item.title: Patch 1.0.15
item.description:
We have a small patch today that fixes an issue which has caused some players to have duplicated terrains and decreased performance. If you have been affected by this there is a possibility that you will have some visual seams in your terrain. Simply deform the terrain along these seams, or walk in the snow there to make the seams disappear. Previously, these seams would re-appear after reloading the area, but now they will persist correctly.
